formulas.formula: y' = \lim_{\Delta x \to 0} \frac{\Delta y}{\Delta x} = \lim_{\Delta x \to 0} \left( -\frac{1}{x^2+x\cdot\Delta x} \right) = -\frac{1}{x^2}.
\frac{\Delta y}{\Delta x} = \frac{f(x+\Delta x)-f(x)}{\Delta x} = \frac{\sqrt{x+\Delta x}-\sqrt{x}}{\Delta x}
y' = \lim_{\Delta x \to 0} \frac{\Delta y}{\Delta x} = \lim_{\Delta x \to 0} \frac{1}{\sqrt{x+\Delta x}+\sqrt{x}} = \frac{1}{2\sqrt{x}}.
若 f(x) = c (c 为常数)，则 f'(x) = 0;
若 f(x) = x^\alpha (\alpha \in \mathbf{R}，且 \alpha \neq 0)，则 f'(x) = \alpha x^{\alpha-1};
若 f(x) = \sin x，则 f'(x) = \cos x;
若 f(x) = \cos x，则 f'(x) = -\sin x;
若 f(x) = a^x (a > 0，且 a \neq 1)，则 f'(x) = a^x \ln a;
若 f(x) = e^x，则 f'(x) = e^x;
若 f(x) = \log_a x (a > 0，且 a \neq 1)，则 f'(x) = \frac{1}{x \ln a};
